description: Admin agents, the owner and finance. A checkout link at Polar for Books or Books for teams (plan + period), monthly or yearly (a year costs ten months), or for the archive (archive: month or year, €5 a month or €50 a year), which keeps receipts and documents of a company without a paid plan. Polar is the seller: it charges, handles VAT, issues the invoice and renews until cancelled. The invoices are in Polar's customer portal (billing.portal). Hand the link to a person of your company. It starts once Polar confirms the payment.
